lede: Round 14 read, on one fight each, that the two choices the gangs' table rests on had flipped: switching encircle on seemed to finish the enemy, and the lure seemed to cost the pack. This page re-measures both over 16 paired fights per opponent on the yard and the Terminus (8 seeds each), with only the table differing. Nothing changes in the game until you choose.
recommendation: Keep the table as shipped (encircle off, bait on). Over seeds neither flip helps on your maps. Encircle on loses to chasers (they end stronger in 12 of the 15 fights that differed) and leaves the pack nearly wiped against a standard element (6% left against 19%). Flipping both is the worst against chasers (13 of 16). Bait on or off is a coin toss. Round 14's one-fight readings were noise. Two drill fixes from tonight are already in every number here: the flanking scouts no longer drive in circles, and the lure now turns and leads the chasers back to the pack (until tonight it charged in alone).

arms.shipped: Best or tied against every opponent on your maps: wins all 16 fights against dug-in guns with the most of the pack left, and leaves chasers at 37% and a standard element at 47%.
arms.encircle: No gain against guns (a little more of the pack lost), a clear loss against chasers (enemy stronger in 12 of 15 fights that differed, pack 1% left), and the pack ends at 6% against a standard element.
arms.nobait: A coin toss against chasers (enemy weaker in 6 fights, stronger in 9) and against a standard element (8 to 8). Identical to shipped against guns, where the lure never fires.
arms.both: The worst against chasers: the enemy ends stronger in 13 of 16 fights and the pack is wiped out in 15.

method: Measured on builder0 at stream/squad efa49762 with make squad-doctrine-series: the gang pack (an IFV leader and three scouts) against each opponent, 90 s or until one side is gone, seeds 1 to 8 on the yard and on the Terminus, every arm on the same seeds (same starts, same fire dice). Pack and enemy left are hull plus shield as a share of the start, averaged over the 16 fights. The last column counts paired fights where the enemy ended weaker or stronger than under the shipped table, with a two-sided sign test. Frames: the drills' own lane at your camera pose, 10 s in.
